headline: Analog Devices (ADI) Could Be 16% Undervalued After Fresh Earnings Optimism
summary: Recent interest in Analog Devices (ADI) has been driven by analyst optimism, supported by upward earnings estimate revisions and a history of earnings surprises that suggest the upcoming quarterly report could attract close attention. See our latest analysis for Analog Devices. Analog Devices’ recent 1-day share price return of 5.09% and 7-day share price return of 7.62% comes after a softer 90-day share price return that declined 6.91%, while the 1-year total shareholder return of 74.63%...
